decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 hydraulic failure at N600-08. Radio and CMMS agree. Repair is in place, likely 09:54 and at worst 10:00. The stope has only 171 t (about 63 oz), and the repaired LH-02 can load it before 17:00. A loan would cost development hours and travel time for about 20-30 min of gain, so I make no moves.

LH-02 is down (radio and CMMS agree). The revised repair estimate puts it back at 14:30 to 17:30, likely 15:30. N600-08 holds 171 t at 11.5 g/t, about 63 oz, which would mostly stay unmucked. LH-08 is on infrastructure heading DS-N600-01, which is worth only 0.5 oz/h, and it is 0.34 h away. After travel and lunch it has about 6 h of loading at 23.6 t/h, roughly 140 t or 52 oz. The heading loses about 3 oz. Norte inflow rises to about 66 t/h against truck capacity of 66 t/h, and the stockpile is only 144 of 450 t, so there is no stockpile constraint. LH-09 stays on DS-N522-02 (2.0 oz/h). The other mines have no idle loaders, and LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 14:00.
